helpful.en: You might be lucky enough to get a response, but often the feedback wouldn’t be very helpful.
helpful.zh: 你可能会幸运地得到回复，但通常反馈并不是很有帮助。

helpful.en: Some people find it helpful to study the vocabulary before listening.
helpful.zh: 有些人发现在听之前学习这些词汇很有帮助。

helpful.en: Yes. So, for adults trying to learn a new language, research has shown that some explicit teaching is helpful.
helpful.zh: 是的。因此，对于试图学习新语言的成年人来说，研究表明一些显性教学是有帮助的。

helpful.en: There is quite a bit of evidence that some explicit teaching of, for example, grammar and vocabulary is helpful.
helpful.zh: 有相当多的证据表明，进行一些显性的教学，例如语法和词汇教学，是有帮助的。

helpful.en: Super helpful, and that hasn’t changed. What has changed is the scale, the speed, and the integration.
helpful.zh: 超级有用，而且这一点没有改变。改变的是规模、速度和集成度。

heat.en: You could smelt metals, fire pottery, heat homes, cook food, and light streets.
heat.zh: 你可以冶炼金属、烧制陶器、温暖房屋、烹饪食物和照亮街道。

heat.en: Well, a typical sauna is a small wooden room heated with steam to around 80°C.
heat.zh: 嗯，典型的桑拿房是一个用蒸汽加热到 80°C 左右的小木屋。

heat.en: But people still needed fire, or rather, the heat that fire gave out.
heat.zh: 但人们仍然需要火，或者更准确地说，需要火散发出的热量。

heat.en: For example, she discovered that radium could constantly produce heat even without an external energy source.
heat.zh: 例如，她发现镭甚至在没有外部能源的情况下也能持续产生热量。

heat.en: I'm like, see, you can feel the heat coming off of me as I go upstairs.
heat.zh: 我说，你看，当我上楼时，你能感觉到我身上散发出的热气。

heading.en: Surely we need to know the trajectory we're heading in, in order to adapt.
heading.zh: 毫无疑问，为了适应气候变化，我们需要了解我们正朝着哪个轨迹前进。

heading.en: Katie had no awareness that she was heading down a dangerous path.
heading.zh: Katie 完全没有意识到自己正在走向一条危险的道路。

heading.en: It's like 25 slides with like a heading and like three bullets on each slide and being like, man, this is good.
heading.zh: 大约25张幻灯片，每张有一个标题和三个要点，心想，天哪，这太棒了。

heading.en: By this point, von Stauffenberg was making a beeline for the perimeter, heading for the exit as quickly as possible.
heading.zh: 此时此刻，冯·施陶芬贝格正直奔警戒线，以最快速度赶往出口。

heading.en: He had been doing one of his favourite activities–watching gladiatorial games–and was heading inside for a spot of lunch.
heading.zh: 他一直在做他最喜欢的活动之一——观看角斗士比赛——并正走进去准备吃点午饭。

heal.en: Jyoti explains that having a strong community also helps reduce or heal climate trauma.
heal.zh: Jyoti 解释说，拥有一个强大的社区，也有助于减轻或疗愈气候创伤。

heal.en: Horse therapist Claudia Nicholson first felt the healing power of horses as a child.
heal.zh: 马匹治疗师 Claudia Nicholson 在孩提时代就第一次感受到了马的治愈力量。

heal.en: Now, poetry helped Maria overcome sadness, but could its power to heal work in other areas too?
heal.zh: 现在，诗歌帮助玛丽亚克服了悲伤，但它的治愈力量也能在其他领域发挥作用吗？

heal.en: Climate trauma is not an individual trauma, it's a community-wide trauma which really requires community-wide healing.
heal.zh: 气候创伤并不是个人层面的创伤，而是整个社区层面的创伤，因此确实需要整个社区共同疗愈。

heal.en: And, you know, we need to strive to heal ourselves.
heal.zh: 而且，你知道，我们需要努力去治愈自己。

herb.en: She'd been inspired by botanical cuisine, the use of edible flowers and herbs to decorate and flavour food.
herb.zh: 她受到了植物料理（botanical cuisine）的启发，即使用食用花卉和草药来装饰食物并为其调味。

herb.en: In Rachel's case, the surprise involved seasoning - the salt, herbs and spices added to food to enhance the flavour.
herb.zh: 在Rachel的例子中，惊喜涉及调味——为增强风味而添加到食物中的盐、草本植物和香料。

herb.en: The UK grows lots of delicious herbs, mint and rosemary and thyme, we use a lot of that in our cooking.
herb.zh: 英国种植了许多美味的草本植物，如薄荷、迷迭香和百里香，我们在烹饪中经常使用它们。

herb.en: Scanning means searching a wide area with your eyes to find some particular thing – in this case, edible plants and herbs.
herb.zh: “观察”（Scanning）意味着用眼睛搜索广阔的区域以寻找特定的东西——在这种情况下，是可食用的植物和草药。

herb.en: A roast joint of beef would usually just be seasoned with salt and pepper, some herbs as well, and then served with vegetables and gravy and perhaps horseradish or mustard.
herb.zh: 一大块烤牛肉通常只用盐、胡椒和一些草药调味，然后搭配蔬菜、肉汁，或许还有辣根或芥末一起食用。

height.en: It was a gigantic territory, greater even than the Roman Empire at its height.
height.zh: 这是一个巨大的领土，甚至比全盛时期的罗马帝国还要大。

height.en: At its height, Tenochtitlán may have had a population of more than 200,000 people.
height.zh: 在其鼎盛时期，特诺奇蒂特兰的人口可能超过了20万。

height.en: Machu Picchu was built in the fifteenth century, I think, during the height of the Inca Empire.
height.zh: 我想马丘比丘建于十五世纪，正值印加帝国的鼎盛时期。

height.en: At the height, I was making between $75,000 and $100,000 a month.
height.zh: 在巅峰时期，我每月的收入在 75,000 到 100,000 美元之间。

height.en: At the height of the financial crisis, fear spread globally.
height.zh: 在金融危机最严重的时候，恐惧在全球蔓延。

heritage.en: People of mixed heritage, usually Spanish and indigenous mixed, formed a growing middle class.
heritage.zh: 拥有混血血统的人（通常是西班牙血统和土著血统的混血）构成了一个不断壮大的中产阶级。

heritage.en: The distinction between UNESCO heritage sites and the New Seven Wonders is important.
heritage.zh: UNESCO遗产地与新世界七大奇迹之间的区别很重要。

heritage.en: From the British Museum’s perspective, their Moai statue is an important part of global heritage.
heritage.zh: 从大英博物馆的角度来看，他们的 Moai 雕像是全球遗产的重要组成部分。

heritage.en: In 2012, UNESCO recognized parts of Rio’s landscape as a World Heritage Site.
heritage.zh: 2012年，联合国教科文组织将里约的部分景观认定为世界遗产。

heritage.en: Canada officially encourages people to keep their own cultural heritage and their own languages while becoming Canadian.
heritage.zh: 加拿大官方鼓励人们在成为加拿大人同时，保留自己的文化遗产和母语。

headline.en: The BBC headline, for example, was: “United Arab Emirates to Quit Oil Cartel OPEC.”
headline.zh: 例如，BBC的头条新闻是：“阿拉伯联合酋长国将退出石油卡特尔OPEC。”

headline.en: We’ll get to my quits later. First, here’s someone who made headlines when he quit.
headline.zh: 我们稍后再谈我的放弃经历。首先，是一位因辞职而登上头条的人。

headline.en: Known as clickbait, headlines like these are used to grab your attention and make you read more.
headline.zh: 这类被称为“标题党”的标题，目的就是吸引你的眼球，让你阅读更多内容。

headline.en: The island actually made international headlines again in 2020, during the Coronavirus outbreak.
headline.zh: 在 2020 年新冠疫情爆发期间，该岛实际上再次登上了国际头条。

headline.en: And the pressure to get more views and earn more money encourages dramatic headlines and careless reporting.
headline.zh: 获取更多点击量和赚取更多资金的压力助长了戏剧化的标题和草率的报道。

heap.en: Or is there stuff everywhere? If your room is filled with heaps of clothes and piles of books, you may have a problem with clutter – things in your home which take up space in an untidy, disorganised way.
heap.zh: 还是到处都是杂物？如果你的房间塞满了成堆的衣服和书，你可能有了杂物堆积的问题——也就是家里那些以凌乱、无组织的方式占用空间的物品。

helpless.en: Although they look small and helpless, babies are born with some amazing abilities.
helpless.zh: 虽然婴儿看起来又小又无助，但他们天生具有一些惊人的能力。

helpless.en: And he was not a mere helpless spectator.
helpless.zh: 他也不是一个无助的旁观者。

helpless.en: I had to even accept the idea that I was as angry as I was, angry and helpless, which is a terrible combination for a human being to experience.
helpless.zh: 我甚至不得不接受这样一个事实：我曾经那么愤怒，既愤怒又无助，这对一个人来说是一种极其糟糕的体验。

hero.en: The Wild West had found its hero. The only problem was that he’d never really existed.
hero.zh: 荒野西部找到了自己的英雄，唯一的问题是，这个英雄其实从未真正存在过。

hero.en: But at this stage, Lawrence was not yet a hero, not yet the legendary “Lawrence of Arabia.”
hero.zh: 但在这个阶段，Lawrence 还不是英雄，还不是传奇的 Lawrence of Arabia。

hero.en: He was a hero. A symbol. The embodiment of law and order in a lawless land.
hero.zh: 他成了一位英雄，一个符号，一个在无法无天之地体现法律与秩序的化身。

hero.en: Oh yes, of course. The show's hero was a dog named Lassie.
hero.zh: 哦，当然记得。剧中的主角是一只名叫 Lassie 的狗。

hero.en: Our unsung hero this week is Seung Kim. Seung is a senior director with the Local Initiatives Support Coalition.
hero.zh: 我们本周的无名英雄是 Seung Kim。Seung 是地方倡议支持联盟（Local Initiatives Support Coalition）的高级主任。

helmet.en: They don't wear firemen's helmets, but these four-legged, fire-fighting friends are really coming to the rescue in Spain.
helmet.zh: 它们虽然不戴消防员头盔，但这些四条腿的'消防员'朋友，确实正在西班牙发挥着救援的作用。

helmet.en: Well, now I have a picture in my head of a cow wearing a fireman's helmet, but I guess that's not what you mean, Neil.
helmet.zh: 这下我脑海里浮现出一头戴着消防员头盔的奶牛，不过我猜这不是你的意思吧，Neil。

herd.en: They hunted. They guarded. They herded. They pulled sleds across frozen landscapes where no other animals could.
herd.zh: 它们狩猎。它们看家。它们放牧。它们在没有任何其他动物能够涉足的冰冻大地上拉雪橇。

herd.en: Herding dogs allowed humans to manage livestock efficiently, protect it from predators, and move it across long distances.
herd.zh: 牧羊犬让人类能够高效地管理牲畜，保护它们免受掠食者的侵害，并带着它们长途迁徙。

herd.en: In his twenties, he worked as a buffalo hunter on the Kansas plains, when the vast herds that had roamed the great plains for centuries were being systematically slaughtered for their hides.
herd.zh: 二十多岁时，他在堪萨斯平原上当过猎捕野牛的猎人，当时那些在大平原上漫游了几个世纪的庞大兽群，正被有计划地大批猎杀以获取兽皮。

herd.en: Supported by Rewilding Spain, Pablo has reintroduced herds of tauros – the species of cow similar to the now-extinct wild aurochs, the ancestor of the modern domestic cow – into the forests of central Spain.
herd.zh: 在 Rewilding Spain 的支持下，Pablo 将成群的原牛(tauros)重新引入了西班牙中部的森林——这是一种与如今已灭绝的野生原牛(现代家牛的祖先)相似的牛种。

headache.en: She mentions feeling tired, having a headache or a dry mouth as symptoms of dehydration.
headache.zh: 她提到感到疲劳、头痛或口干是脱水的症状。

headache.en: Is clay good for: a) curing headaches? b) digesting food? or, c) smoothing face skin?
headache.zh: 粘土有何妙用：a) 治疗头痛？b) 消化食物？还是 c) 平滑面部皮肤？

headache.en: You might have had a headache. There might have been someone coughing behind you throughout the listening test.
headache.zh: 你可能头痛。在听力测试期间，你身后可能一直有人在咳嗽。

headache.en: I had a headache. My friends were dehydrated.
headache.zh: 我头疼。我的朋友们脱水了。

headache.en: But first, Georgie, a question. We all know the common cold – now, that’s the illness that makes you cough and sneeze, have a sore throat and headache.
headache.zh: 但首先，Georgie，有个问题。我们都知道普通感冒——也就是那种让你咳嗽、打喷嚏、喉咙痛和头疼的疾病。

hence.en: There is Punch himself. There is his wife Judy, hence the name, "Punch and Judy".
hence.zh: 有 Punch 本人。有他的妻子 Judy，因此得名“Punch and Judy”。

hence.en: Hence, they gradually passed on those genetics.
hence.zh: 因此，它们逐渐将这些基因遗传了下去。

hence.en: Hence, HENRY… High Earner Not Rich Yet. Most often HENRYs are professionals working in corporate careers in their 20s, 30s, and 40s.
hence.zh: 因此叫做HENRY……高收入却尚未富裕。通常HENRY是二十多岁、三十多岁和四十多岁在企业界工作的专业人士。

hence.en: Traditionally, this is eaten on Sundays, hence the name, and it involves roasted meat, chicken, pork, lamb, beef, sometimes other things like turkey as well potatoes, vegetables, gravy, Yorkshire pudding.
hence.zh: 传统上，这道菜在周日食用，因此得名，它包括烤肉（鸡肉、猪肉、羊肉、牛肉，有时也有火鸡等其他肉类）、土豆、蔬菜、肉汁和约克郡布丁。

hence.en: The Italian state made a conscious choice to maintain legal ties to these people and their descendants, even generations later — hence the extremely generous rules on citizenship by descent.
hence.zh: 意大利政府有意识地选择与这些人及其后代保持法律联系，哪怕已经过了好几代人——这也是为什么通过血统获得公民身份的规则极其宽容的原因。

hell.en: Oh, well, that's an extra special level of hell that you've descended into.
hell.zh: 哦，好吧，那是你坠入的另一个特殊层级的地狱。

hell.en: By 25? Not so much. If I were put through Hell Week?
hell.zh: 到了25岁？就没那么容易了。如果让我经历地狱周？

hell.en: Hell yeah, I have free will. My mind-body system can't predict what I'm going to do next.
hell.zh: 当然有，我有自由意志。我的身心系统无法预测我接下来要做什么。

hell.en: And there's a famous phrase that entered Irish historical memory from this period, "To Hell or to Connacht".
hell.zh: 这一时期有一句名言进入了爱尔兰的历史记忆：“要么下地狱，要么去康诺特”。

hell.en: And in many versions, there is the devil himself, who arrives at the end to drag Mr Punch off to hell.
hell.zh: 在许多版本中，甚至还有魔鬼本人，他在最后登场，把 Mr Punch 拖进地狱。

heating.en: Wood for building ships, for building houses, for heating: all of it was scarce and getting increasingly expensive.
heating.zh: 用于建造船只、建造房屋、取暖的木材：所有这些都十分稀缺，而且变得越来越昂贵。

heating.en: Putin grew up in what we would now describe as extreme poverty: living in a communal apartment without heating or its own toilet.
heating.zh: 普京在如今会被形容为极度贫困的环境中长大：住在没有暖气、也没有独立厕所的合住公寓里。

heating.en: Cars, aeroplanes, ships, factories, central heating, electric light: all of it, at its root, a consequence of setting fire to stuff and using its heat.
heating.zh: 汽车、飞机、轮船、工厂、中央暖气、电灯：这一切，从根本上讲，都是点燃东西并利用其热量的结果。

heavily.en: These temporary barriers were soon replaced by a complex and heavily fortified wall system.
heavily.zh: 这些临时屏障很快就被一个复杂且戒备森严的墙体系统所取代。

heavily.en: It was heavily defended from the sea, where the Ottomans expected any attack to come.
heavily.zh: 奥斯曼人预料攻击会来自海上，因此在海防方面戒备森严。

heavily.en: The National Health Service in the UK still relies heavily on overseas staff.
heavily.zh: 英国的国家医疗服务体系（NHS）仍然严重依赖海外员工。

heavily.en: They weren’t as heavily armoured as the Roman troops, but they were bold and adaptable.
heavily.zh: 他们的盔甲没有罗马军队那么厚重，但他们勇敢且适应力极强。

heavily.en: These were very valuable things. These plantations relied heavily on African slaves.
heavily.zh: 这些是非常有价值的东西。这些种植园严重依赖非洲奴隶。

heir.en: But with no direct heirs, all eyes turned, yet again, to the next generation.
heir.zh: 但由于没有直系继承人，所有人的目光又一次转向了下一代。

heir.en: That he was the son of the king and the rightful heir to the throne of Athens.
heir.zh: 他是国王的儿子，也是雅典王位的合法继承人。

heir.en: To show a facade of continuity, Saudi state television broadcast a clip of the newly appointed MBS kneeling to kiss the hand of the deposed heir, MBN.
heir.zh: 为了营造一种权力平稳过渡的表象，沙特国家电视台播出了新任王储MBS下跪亲吻被废黜的继承人MBN手背的片段。

heir.en: After much manoeuvring, he named his stepson, Tiberius, as his heir on the condition that Tiberius adopt his nephew, Germanicus, as his own son, so the title of emperor would pass first to Tiberius, then to Germanicus.
heir.zh: 经过一番周旋，他将继子 Tiberius 指定为继承人，条件是 Tiberius 必须收养他的侄子 Germanicus 为养子，因此皇帝的头衔将首先传给 Tiberius，然后传给 Germanicus。

headquarters.en: Berlin was the center of Nazi power. Government ministries and party headquarters and different security organizations, were all based in the city.
headquarters.zh: 柏林是纳粹权力的中心。政府部门、党总部和不同的安全组织都设在该市。

headquarters.en: Chaos breaks out. There was a firefight at the Bendlerblock, the Berlin headquarters where several of the conspirators were based, and von Stauffenberg was shot in the arm.
headquarters.zh: 混乱爆发了。在柏林总部本德勒布洛克（Bendlerblock，许多阴谋分子的大本营）发生了一场枪战，冯·施陶芬贝格的手臂中枪。

headquarters.en: In the early afternoon of July 20th, 1944, twenty or so senior Nazi officials were gathered around a long oak table in the Wolf’s Lair, Hitler’s military headquarters on the Eastern Front, in modern-day Poland.
headquarters.zh: 1944年7月20日刚过正午，大约二十名纳粹高级官员聚集在“狼穴”（Wolf’s Lair）的一张长橡木桌旁，这里是希特勒在东线（位于今天的波兰）的军事总部。

headquarters.en: All accounts point to a charismatic and brave leader; this was not a man who sat back at headquarters and moved around pretend soldiers on a map, this was a decorated, respected and highly effective military leader.
headquarters.zh: 所有记录都指向一位富有领袖魅力且勇敢的领袖；他不是那种坐在指挥部里在地图上调兵遣将的人，而是一位战功卓著、备受尊敬且效率极高的军事领袖。

headquarters.en: This thankfully has now changed, the BBC encourages a variety of accents, and it now has a headquarters in Manchester, but while I was growing up at least, everyone you heard on the BBC spoke in a particular way; they spoke like a Southerner.
headquarters.zh: 值得庆幸的是，现在情况已经改变了，BBC 鼓励多元口音，并且现在在曼彻斯特也设有总部，但至少在我成长的年代，你在 BBC 上听到的每个人说话都是同一个调调；听起来都像南方人。

heroic.en: He was the son of the heroic general Germanicus and the adopted grandson of Rome’s first emperor, Augustus.
heroic.zh: 他是英雄将军 Germanicus 的儿子，也是罗马第一位皇帝 Augustus 的养孙。

heroic.en: However, tragedy struck. Germanicus, this heroic military leader who seemed poised to become the next emperor, died suddenly in Syria in AD 19, at the age of 33.
heroic.zh: 然而，悲剧降临了。Germanicus 这位似乎注定要成为下一任皇帝的英雄军事统帅，于公元19年在叙利亚突然去世，享年33岁。

heighten.en: Mubarak used the threat of Islamic extremism to continue the country’s “state of emergency”, which gave the state heightened powers to arrest, detain, and question if there was even the tiniest inkling of wrongdoing, and in many cases, even if there wasn’t.
heighten.zh: Mubarak 利用伊斯兰极端主义的威胁来延续国家的“紧急状态”，这赋予了国家更大的权力去逮捕、拘留和审讯那些哪怕只有一丝一毫违法苗头的人，在许多情况下，甚至连这种苗头都没有也不放过。

heel.en: Morsi dug his heels, insisting he was the legitimate president, elected by the people, which of course, technically he was.
heel.zh: Morsi 固执己见，坚称自己是合法总统，由人民选出，当然从技术上讲他确实是。

heaven.en: The idea was simple: if something smelled heavenly, it was probably appreciated by the heavens.
heaven.zh: 这个想法很简单：如果某种东西闻起来像天堂一样香，那么神灵可能也会喜欢。

heaven.en: I love spending time by myself. But man, when I can dig a hole under that gate and connect with other kids, I'm in heaven.
heaven.zh: 我喜欢自己待着。但是，伙计，当我能钻过那个大门去和别的孩子交流时，我就像在天堂一样。

hemisphere.en: Brazil was one of the last countries in the Western Hemisphere to abolish slavery.
hemisphere.zh: 巴西是西半球最后一个废除奴隶制的国家之一。

hemisphere.en: People in a linear culture might answer July and August (if you’re in the Northern Hemisphere).
hemisphere.zh: 我们说七月和八月，因为日程表上就是这么定的。

hesitate.en: They do things like apologizing for their language level or hesitating before every sentence.
hesitate.zh: 他们会做一些诸如为自己的语言水平道歉，或者在每个句子前犹豫不决的事情。
他们在回答问题前犹豫不决。

helicopter.en: For example, he sketched things that resembled helicopters and parachutes.
helicopter.zh: 例如，他画了一些类似于直升机和降落伞的东西。

helicopter.en: So you'll hear the invite, but make the decision? because if you're if there's fewer things in coming you're assuming that you know what's i don't commit to anything in the future so i'll say okay if that thing is interesting i'll see if i can get in that day when i'm in the mood but there's nothing worse than something coming up that your past self committed you to your present self doesn't want to do god damn it past it of all yeah and then it destroys your entire calendar uh it destroys your day because there's like oh this one hour slot which is sitting like a turd on my calendar that i have to like schedule my whole day around i can't do anything at 20 minutes before the 20 minutes afterwards even for phone calls if someone wants to do a phone call say okay just text me when you're free i'll text you when i'm free and we'll just do it on the fly it's a much better way of living than this overly scheduled uh you know cal.com or i cal whatever the uh the overscheduled life is not worth living it's not i think it's a terrible way to live life that's not how we evolve it's not how we grew up it's not how we were as children hopefully unless you have a helicopter parent or a tiger mom your natural order is freedom i had a friend who uh said to me once you know uh i never want to have to be at a specific place at a specific time and i was like oh my god that's freedom when i heard that that changed my life right you still a alarm clock alarm clockless yes i'm alarm clock today i did set my alarm just so i wouldn't miss very important yeah if you still just so you know i set the alarm clock from 11 a.m in case i was stricken with a flu i wasn't gonna set my alarm clock for 8 a.m. or 9 a.m.
helicopter.zh: 所以你会听到邀请，但会自己做决定？因为如果你……如果进来的事情变少了，你是在假设你知道什么是……我不对未来的任何事情做承诺，所以我会说，好吧，如果那件事很有趣，我会看看那天我是否有心情去参加。但没有什么比你过去的自己为你承诺了某事，而现在的你却不想做更糟糕的了。该死的过去的自己！是的，然后它会毁了你的整个日历。它会毁了你的一天，因为就像，“哦，这一个小时的空档就像一坨屎一样卡在我的日历上”，我必须围绕它来安排我的一整天。我甚至不能在它之前或之后的20分钟里做任何事。即使是打电话，如果有人想通话，我会说，好吧，当你空闲时给我发短信，我空闲时也会给你发短信，我们随时随地进行。这比那种过度安排的生活方式好得多，你知道的，cal.com 或者 iCal，无论那种过度安排的生活是什么，都不值得过。真的不值得。我认为那是一种糟糕的生活方式，那不是我们进化而来的方式，不是我们成长的方式，也不是我们小时候的样子。除非你有直升机父母或虎妈，否则你自然的秩序就是自由。我有个朋友曾经对我说：“你知道吗，我永远不想被迫在特定的时间出现在特定的地点。”我当时就想，天哪，那就是自由。当我听到那句话时，它改变了我的人生。对吧？你现在还是不用闹钟吗？不用闹钟，是的。今天我确实设了闹钟，只是为了不耽误非常重要的事情。是的，如果你还……只是为了让你知道，我把闹钟设在上午11点，以防我得了流感。我可不会把闹钟设在早上8点或9点。
